exclusion_detail: The lead is the novel aryl-OMe 2-methylbenzimidazole sulfonate analog the models predicted to have a higher DSC onset (119 C); the main text contains no experimental section, and says analog preparation is in the Supporting Information ('see Supporting Information for details'), which is not in the bundle (preprint, data-science paper). Its precursor (compound 1, a chlorosulfate) is also only 'previously disclosed'.

lead.label: aryl-OMe 2-Me-benzimidazole analog (Fig. 6D)
lead.why: Abstract: 'The resulting models were deployed to predict a novel analog with a higher onset temperature'; text: 'an aryl-OMe derivative was synthesized to test the model ... exhibited a higher DSC onset value of 119 C'.

notes: No procedures anywhere in the main text (checked the whole file: results/discussion and conclusion only). Structure of the lead is only a drawing (text layer gives no name), so not even the target could be written without guessing.
